questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A man sued to assert an interest in the large estate of an elderly woman who had died intestate. The man claimed to be the woman's nephew. At trial, the man produced a genealogy chart which was authenticated as belonging to the woman. The genealogy chart contained members of the woman's family in generations both before and after her and recorded the man's birth to the woman's oldest sister.
Is the information in the genealogy chart admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the man did not produce the creator of the chart.
choices.C: Yes, as a recorded recollection.
choices.D: Yes, as proof that the man is entitled to a portion of the woman's estate.

questions.explanation:
Examples of family records excepted from hearsay
(FRE 803(13))
  • Family bible
  • Genealogy
  • Family chart
  • Engraving on ring or urn
  • Inscription on portrait
  • Engraving/inscription on burial marker
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the rule against hearsay, out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein are inadmissible unless an exclusion or exception applies. One hearsay exception applies to statements of fact about personal or family history contained in a family record (eg, genealogy chart). Once the family record is authenticated,* the information in that record is admissible to prove the truth of the matter asserted.

Accordingly, the genealogy chart is admissible to prove that the man is the woman's nephew and is therefore entitled to a portion of her estate (Choice D).

*A party authenticates an item of tangible evidence by introducing evidence sufficient to support a finding that the item is what the party claims it is.

(Choice B) A statement of fact about family history contained in a family record is admissible under this hearsay exception regardless of the declarant's availability. Therefore, the fact that the man did not produce the creator (ie, declarant) of the genealogy chart at trial is not a basis to exclude it.

(Choice C) The hearsay exception for recorded recollections allows a record to be read into evidence if (1) concerns a matter the witness once knew but cannot recall at trial, (2) was made or adopted by the witness when the matter was fresh in his/her mind, and (3) accurately reflects the witness's personal knowledge at the time it was made. Here, the man did not suffer a memory lapse and there is no indication that he adopted the genealogy chart at the time it was made, so this exception does not apply.

📌 Educational Objective

One hearsay exception applies to statements of fact about personal or family history contained in a family record. Once authenticated, the information in that record is admissible to prove the truth of the matter asserted.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(13) (hearsay exception for statements regarding personal or family history in family records).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子提起诉讼，主张对一位未立遗嘱去世的年长女性的大额遗产享有权益。该男子声称自己是该女性的侄甥。在庭审中，该男子出示了一份家谱图，该家谱图经鉴定属于该女性。该家谱图包含了该女性前后几代家庭成员的信息，并记录了该男子系由该女性的长姐所生。

该家谱图中的信息是否具有可采性？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该证据属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该男子未能让家谱图的制作者出庭。
zh-choices.C: 是，可作为有记录的回忆。
zh-choices.D: 是，可作为该男子有权获得部分女方遗产的证明。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions

本题考察的是证据法中关于传闻证据（Hearsay）的一个具体例外：家庭记录（Family Records）。

⚖️ 核心法则：FRE 803(13)

《联邦证据规则》规定，关于个人或家族历史的事实陈述（如出生、婚姻、血缘关系等），如果包含在家庭记录中，则不被视为不可采的传闻证据。

常见的家庭记录包括：

📖 家庭圣经 (Family Bibles)
🌳 家谱 (Genealogies)
📊 图表 (Charts)
💍 戒指刻字 (Engravings on rings)
⚱️ 墓碑铭文 (Inscriptions on markers)

📝 案情分析

在本案中，男子试图通过一份家谱图（Genealogy Chart）来证明自己是死者的侄子（从而有权继承遗产）。

  1. 传闻性质：家谱图是庭外陈述，被用来证明其内容的真实性（即男子确实是亲属），因此属于传闻。
  2. 例外适用：该图表符合 FRE 803(13) 中“家庭记录”的定义。
  3. 基础条件：题目明确指出该图表“经鉴定属于该女性” (authenticated as belonging to the woman)。

因此，该证据具有可采性（Admissible）。

✅ 正确选项解析 (D)

选项 D 正确

"Yes, as proof that the man is entitled to a portion of the woman's estate."

既然家谱图符合传闻证据的例外，它就可以被接纳为证据。一旦被接纳，它就可以用来证明该男子与死者的亲属关系，进而证明他有权分得遗产。

❌ 错误选项干扰点

选项 A 错误

理由：虽然它是传闻，但它符合 FRE 803(13) 的例外，因此不能以传闻为由排除。

选项 B 错误

理由：FRE 803 系列的例外属于"Availability of Declarant Immaterial"（陈述人是否在场无关紧要）。无论家谱图的制作者是否出庭，只要通过了鉴定（Authentication），该记录本身就是可采的。

选项 C 错误

理由：Recorded Recollection (FRE 803(5)) 要求证人在庭上“想不起来了”，且记录必须是证人自己制作或认可的。本案中男子没有失忆，图表也不是他做的，故不适用此例外。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据法题目中，区分 FRE 803 和 FRE 804 至关重要：
  • FRE 803：不需要陈述人缺席（如：现有精神状态、商业记录、家庭记录）。
  • FRE 804：必须证明陈述人“不可获得”（Unavailable）（如：临终遗言、违反利益的陈述）。
看到“家谱”、“圣经”或“墓碑”上的文字，直接联想 FRE 803(13)，无需考虑制作者去哪了。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
At a defendant's trial for theft, a witness called by the prosecutor testified to the following: (1) that from his apartment window, he saw thieves across the street break the window of a jewelry store, take jewelry, and leave in a car; (2) that his wife telephoned the police and relayed to them the license number of the thieves' car as the witness looked out the window with binoculars and read it to her; and (3) that he has no present memory of the number, but that immediately afterward he listened to a playback of the police tape recording giving the license number (which belongs to the defendant's car) and verified that she had relayed the number accurately.
Is playing the tape recording for the jury proper?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the witness's wife lacked firsthand knowledge of the license number.
choices.C: Yes, because it is a public record or report.
choices.D: Yes, because it is a recorded recollection.

questions.explanation:
Recorded recollection
(FRE 803(5))

Hearsay exception—regardless of declarant's availability—for records that:

  • concern matter witness once knew but cannot recall at trial
  • witness made or adopted when matter was fresh in his/her mind and
  • accurately reflect witness's personal knowledge at time record was made
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay generally bars the admission of an out-of-court statement (eg, tape recording) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, license number). But if a statement falls within an exclusion or exception to this rule, it is admissible as substantive evidence. One such exception applies to a recorded recollection, which allows a record to be read—or, in the case of audio recordings, played—into evidence if it:

  • concerns a matter that a witness once knew but cannot recall at trial
  • was made or adopted by the witness when the matter was fresh in his/her mind and
  • accurately reflects the witness's personal knowledge at the time it was made.

Here, the witness testified that he had no memory of the license plate number he had read to his wife as he watched the thieves leave the jewelry store. But immediately after reporting the burglary—ie, while the matter was fresh in his mind—the witness adopted the recording by verifying that it accurately reflected the number he had read to his wife. Therefore, the recording is admissible under the hearsay exception for recorded recollections and can be played to the jury (Choice A).

(Choice B) The witness's wife did not need to have firsthand knowledge of the license plate number for the recording to be admissible as a recorded recollection. That is because the witness adopted the recording and verified its accuracy.

(Choice C) The public records exception to the hearsay rule applies to a public office's records or statements that set out (1) office activities, (2) matters observed by office representatives while under a legal duty to report, and (3) factual findings from legally authorized investigations when offered in civil cases or against the government in criminal cases. But the tape recording falls outside these categories.

📌 Educational Objective

A record that (1) concerns a matter a witness once knew but cannot recall, (2) the witness made or adopted when the matter was fresh in mind, and (3) accurately reflects the witness's personal knowledge is admissible as a recorded recollection.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(5) (hearsay exception – recorded recollection).
questions.zh-question:
在一名被告的盗窃罪审判中，检方传唤的一名证人作证如下：（1）他从自己的公寓窗户看到街对面的窃贼打破一家珠宝店的窗户，拿走珠宝，然后乘车离开；（2）当他用双筒望远镜看着窗外并向妻子念出窃贼的车牌号时，他的妻子给警察打了电话，并向警方转述了该车牌号；（3）他目前不记得该号码，但在事后他立即听了警方关于该车牌号（该车牌属于被告的车辆）的录音回放，并核实了他的妻子准确地转述了该号码。

向陪审团播放该录音是否适当？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为这是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为证人的妻子对车牌号码缺乏第一手认知。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为这是一份公共记录或报告。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为这属于有记录的回忆。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions
核心考点：过去的回忆记录 Recorded Recollection (FRE 803(5))

当证人在法庭上无法记起某个事项时，可以将之前的记录作为证据宣读或播放给陪审团，前提是满足以下三个条件：

  • 证人曾经对该事项有第一手认知 (Personal Knowledge)；
  • 记录是在证人对此事记忆犹新时制作或采纳的 (Made or adopted when fresh)；
  • 记录准确反映了证人当时的认知。
为什么选 D？

本题是 Recorded Recollection 的教科书式案例。让我们拆解逻辑链条：

1. 遗忘 (Memory Loss):
证人在庭审时作证说他“目前不记得该号码” (no present memory)。这满足了引入记录的前提条件。

2. 采纳 (Adoption):
虽然电话是妻子打的，但证人作证说他“事后立即听了回放”并“核实了妻子转述的准确性”。
关键点：通过核实录音，丈夫将妻子的口述采纳 (Adopted) 为自己的陈述。

3. 时效性与准确性 (Freshness & Accuracy):
核实发生在“紧接着” (immediately afterward)，当时记忆犹新，且他确认录音准确。

因此，该录音符合 FRE 803(5) 的所有要素，可以作为证据播放给陪审团。

其他选项为何错误？
选项 A (Hearsay):
虽然录音确实是传闻证据 (Hearsay)，但它符合“过去的回忆记录”这一传闻例外，因此可以采纳。
选项 B (Wife's Knowledge):
这是一个常见的干扰项。虽然妻子没有看到车牌，但她只是充当了传声筒。因为丈夫（目击者）事后立即核实并采纳了录音内容，所以录音的有效性建立在丈夫的第一手认知上，而非妻子的。
选项 C (Public Record):
警方录音通常不自动构成“公共记录例外” (Public Records Exception, FRE 803(8)) 来证明证人陈述的真实性。此外，针对刑事被告，警方观察到的事项记录通常受到严格限制。本题最精准的依据是 803(5)。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

区分 Refreshed 与 Recorded：
  • Present Recollection Refreshed (FRE 612): 给证人看文件是为了唤醒记忆。如果唤醒了，证人口头作证，文件本身通常不作为证据呈堂。
  • Recorded Recollection (FRE 803(5)): 证人彻底忘了，看文件也没用。此时，文件内容被宣读/播放进记录，作为实质证据。

注意：根据 FRE 803(5)，该记录只能被宣读或播放，不能作为实物证据 (Exhibit) 提交给陪审团带入审议室，除非由对方律师提出。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A man and his friend were charged with conspiracy to dispose of a stolen diamond necklace. The friend jumped bail and cannot be found.
Proceeding to trial against the man alone, the prosecutor calls a witness, the friend's sister, to testify that the friend confided to her that "[The man] said I still owe him some of the money from selling that necklace."
Is the sister's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the friend is not shown to have firsthand knowledge that the necklace was stolen.
choices.B: No, because the friend's statement was not in furtherance of the conspiracy.
choices.C: Yes, as evidence of a statement against interest by the friend.
choices.D: Yes, as evidence of a statement by party-opponent by the friend.

questions.explanation:
Hearsay
Out-of-court statement offered for truth of matter asserted therein
Inadmissible unless
Excluded (ie, nonhearsay)
Declarant-witness
  • Prior inconsistent statement
  • Prior consistent statement for rehabilitation
  • Prior identification
Party-opponent
  • Made or adopted by party
  • Made by agent, employee, coconspirator, or authorized person
Excepted
Unavailable declarant
  • Former testimony
  • Dying declaration
  • Statement against interest
  • Personal/family history
  • Against party that wrongly caused declarant's absence
Other inherently reliable statements
  • Present sense impression
  • Then-existing state of mind
  • Etc.
Admissible

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is inadmissible unless it falls within a hearsay exclusion or exception. One hearsay exclusion applies to statements by a party-opponent that are offered against that party—e.g., the man's statement that the friend owed the man money. But since the man's statement is contained within the friend's hearsay statement (i.e., hearsay within hearsay), neither statement is admissible unless the friend's statement is also admissible.

A statement made by a co-conspirator may be admissible as an opposing party's statement against other co-conspirators, but only if the statement was made during and in furtherance of the conspiracy. But here, the statement was not made during and in furtherance of the conspiracy—i.e., an agreement between two or more persons to commit a crime (e.g., sell stolen property)—because the necklace had been sold (Choices B and D). Therefore, the friend's statement is not excluded from hearsay as an opposing party's statement.

However, the friend's statement may fall within the hearsay exception for statements against interest. This exception applies to statements made by an unavailable declarant that a reasonable person would only have made if it were true (e.g., because it exposes one to civil or criminal liability).

Here, the friend is unavailable because he jumped bail. And his statement—"[the man] said I still owe him some of the money from selling that necklace"—exposes him to criminal liability for conspiring with the man. As a result, it falls within this hearsay exception and the sister's testimony about the friend's statement (and the man's statement contained therein) is admissible.

(Choice A) Proof of firsthand knowledge is not necessary to admit the friend's statement under the statement against interest exception (or any other exception) to the hearsay rule.

📌 Educational Objective

Out-of-court statements offered for the truth asserted therein are only admissible if they fall within a hearsay exclusion or exception. And if such a statement is contained within another (i.e., hearsay within hearsay), then neither statement is admissible unless both are excluded or excepted from hearsay.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 805 (hearsay within hearsay).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(3) (hearsay exceptions for statements against interest).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子和他的朋友被指控共谋处置一条盗窃来的钻石项链。朋友弃保潜逃，无法找到。

在仅对该男子进行的审判中，检察官传唤一名证人，即该朋友的妹妹，来作证说该朋友曾向她吐露：“[那名男子]说我卖那条项链的钱还有一部分欠他的。”

该妹妹的证词是否可被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为没有证据表明该朋友对项链是盗窃物有第一手认知。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为该朋友的陈述并非为了促进共谋。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，作为该朋友作出的不利于其自身利益的陈述的证据。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，作为对方当事人的共谋者所作陈述的证据。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay within Hearsay

核心考点

多重传闻 (Double Hearsay)

本题考查的是典型的“传闻中的传闻”。根据 FRE 805，每一层陈述都必须符合传闻例外或排除规则，整个证据才能被采纳。

1
内层 (Inner): 男子对朋友说
"I still owe him money..."
⬇
2
外层 (Outer): 朋友对妹妹说
"Man said I owe him..."
⬇
3
庭审: 妹妹出庭作证

第一层分析：男子的陈述

男子是被告。检察官将男子自己的话作为证据来指控他。

  • 规则：FRE 801(d)(2)(A)
  • 定性：对方当事人的陈述 (Opposing Party's Statement)。
  • 结论：在联邦证据规则下，这不属于传闻 (Non-hearsay)。第一层通过。

第二层分析：朋友的陈述

这是本题的关键。朋友在庭外对妹妹说话，且朋友已“弃保潜逃”无法出庭。

为什么选 C (Statement Against Interest)?

  • 不可出庭 (Unavailability): 朋友失踪，符合 FRE 804(a) 的要求。
  • 违背利益 (Against Interest): 朋友承认自己卖了项链并欠同伙钱。这不仅承认了民事债务，更承认了参与处理赃物（刑事犯罪）。
  • 逻辑：正常人不会随意承认自己犯罪，除非是真的。因此，该陈述具有可信度，符合 FRE 804(b)(3) 例外。

为什么不选 D (Co-conspirator)?

这是最强的干扰项。

  • 规则：FRE 801(d)(2)(E) 规定，共谋者的陈述若要被采纳，必须是在共谋过程中，且为了促进共谋 (in furtherance of the conspiracy) 而作出的。
  • 本案事实：朋友向妹妹“吐露” (confided) 心声，这通常被视为闲聊或叙述过去发生的事，并没有推进共谋的目标（如销赃、掩盖罪行等）。
  • 结论：虽然他们是共谋者，但这句话不是为了共谋说的，所以不能用此规则排除传闻。

为什么不选 A 和 B?

  • 选项 A (第一手认知): 违背利益的陈述不需要像庭审证人那样严格证明“第一手认知”。而且，承认自己卖了项链本身就暗示了认知的存在。
  • 选项 B (非促进共谋): 这个选项的前半句是对的（确实不是为了促进共谋），但结论是错的（认为不可采纳）。它忽略了证据可以通过另一个路径（即选项 C 的违背利益陈述）被采纳。

🎓 考试通关技巧

遇到 Double Hearsay 题目时：

  1. 画出链条：谁对谁说了什么？
  2. 由内向外：先看最里面的话（通常是被告的话，属于 Party Opponent）。
  3. 检查外层：中间传话的人（本题中的朋友）是否可用？
    👉 如果不可用 (Unavailable)，优先考虑 Statement Against Interest (804(b)(3))。
    👉 如果是为了促进犯罪，考虑 Co-conspirator (801(d)(2)(E))。注意：向家人、警察自首或闲聊通常不属于“促进共谋”。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a murder prosecution, the defendant testified that the killing had occurred in self-defense when the victim tried to shoot him. In rebuttal, the prosecution seeks to call the victim's father to testify that the day before the killing the victim told her father that she loved the defendant so much she could never hurt him.
Is the victim's father's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the victim's character is not an issue.
choices.C: Yes, as a statement of the declarant's then-existing state of mind.
choices.D: Yes, because the victim is unavailable as a witness.

questions.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind
(FRE 803(3))
Hearsay exception for statements of declarant's (available or not) then-existing:
  • state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan)
  • emotional, sensory, or physical condition (eg, mental state, pain, bodily health)
BUT NOT
  • memory of past events or belief unless related to validity or terms of declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The hearsay rule generally bars the admission of an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But there is an exception for statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind—eg, motive, intent, plan—which can be admitted as substantive proof that the declarant later acted in accordance with that state of mind. This is true regardless of the declarant's availability as a witness.

Here, the victim's out-of-court statement that she loved the defendant so much she could never hurt him is hearsay since it is being offered for its truth. But since the statement concerns the victim's lack of motive to harm the defendant, it falls within the then-existing state of mind exception to the hearsay rule. Therefore, the statement is admissible to prove that the victim did not try to shoot the defendant—regardless of her availability as a witness (Choices A & D).

(Choice B) In a murder trial, the prosecution can introduce reputation or opinion testimony about the victim's peaceful character to rebut the defendant's claim of self-defense. Therefore, the victim's character (ie, her general propensity for peacefulness) could be an issue in this case.

📌 Educational Objective

One hearsay exception is for statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan), which can be admitted as substantive proof that the declarant later acted in accordance with that state of mind.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception – declarant's then-existing state of mind).
questions.zh-question:
在一起谋杀案起诉中，被告作证称，杀人行为是出于正当防卫，因为当时受害人试图开枪射杀他。

在反驳环节，控方试图传唤受害人的父亲作证，证明在案发前一天，受害人曾告诉其父亲，她深爱被告，绝不可能伤害他。

受害人父亲的证言是否可被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为受害人的品格并非争议点。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，因为该陈述属于陈述人当时存在的精神状态的陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，因为受害人无法作为证人出庭。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions
正确答案：C 可采纳，因为该陈述属于陈述人当时存在的精神状态。
(Yes, as a statement of the declarant's then-existing state of mind.)
核心考点：FRE 803(3)

当时存在的精神、情感或身体状况 (Then-Existing State of Mind)

传闻证据的一项重要例外。如果陈述是关于陈述人当时的：

  • 动机 (Motive)
  • 意图 (Intent)
  • 计划 (Plan)
  • 情感感觉 (Emotional feeling)
则该陈述可以被采纳，用于证明陈述人随后的行为符合该精神状态。

逻辑推演

1 识别传闻 (Hearsay)

受害人对父亲说“我深爱被告，绝不可能伤害他”。这是庭外陈述，且控方试图用它来证明内容的真实性（即她真的爱他，因此没有攻击动机）。这属于传闻。

2 寻找例外 (Exception)

根据 FRE 803(3)，受害人表达“爱”和“不会伤害”的陈述，直接反映了她当时的情感状态和意图。

3 关联性 (Relevance)

这种精神状态证据可以用来推断行为（Hillmon Doctrine）。
逻辑链条：受害人爱被告（精神状态）→ 受害人不太可能先动手攻击被告（推断行为）→ 反驳被告的“正当防卫”主张。

⚠️ 常见陷阱与错误选项分析
  • 选项 A (Hearsay): 错误。虽然是传闻，但符合 803(3) 例外，所以可以采纳。
  • 选项 B (Character): 错误。虽然品格证据有特定规则，但本题的核心在于该具体陈述的可采性。此外，在自卫案件中，受害人的“平和品格”通常是允许辩论的争议点。
  • 选项 D (Unavailable): 这是一个经典的干扰项。
    FRE 803 类例外（包括 State of Mind）不要求陈述人必须无法出庭 (Availability is immaterial)。
    只有 FRE 804 类例外（如临终遗言 Dying Declaration）才要求陈述人 Unavailable。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
Plaintiff, a management trainee, brought a sex discrimination lawsuit against her employer for wrongful termination of her employment. At trial, the plaintiff is prepared to testify that a janitor at the company told her that he had heard her supervisor say to other male coworkers about her, "Make it hard for her. Maybe she'll go home where she belongs."
Is the plaintiff's proposed testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the janitor's statement is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the statements of both the janitor and the supervisor are hearsay not within any exception.
choices.C: Yes, because the janitor's statement is a present sense impression, and the supervisor's statement is a statement of his then-existing state of mind.
choices.D: Yes, because the statements of both the janitor and the supervisor are statements concerning a matter within the scope of their employment.

questions.explanation:
Under the rule against hearsay, out-of-court statements offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein are generally inadmissible. And when testimony consists of double hearsay—ie, a hearsay statement contained within another hearsay statement—each statement must be independently admissible before a jury can consider that testimony. This requires that both statements fall within a:

  • hearsay exclusion—eg, a statement made by the opposing party's employee within the scope of employment and offered against the opposing party or
  • hearsay exception—eg, a statement describing an event or condition made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it (ie, a present sense impression).

Here, the plaintiff seeks to testify about the janitor's statement regarding the supervisor's statement. Both out-of-court statements are being offered for their truth. But since the supervisor's statement was made within the scope of his employment and is being offered against the employer (a party-opponent), it is excluded from the hearsay rule (Choice B).

However, the janitor's out-of-court statement was made outside the scope of his employment because the statement was not relevant to his work duties (Choice D). Therefore, it does not fall within this hearsay exclusion (or any other exclusion). And the statement is not a present sense impression because it was not made while or immediately after the janitor heard the supervisor (Choice C). And since the statement does not fall within any other hearsay exception, the plaintiff's proposed testimony is inadmissible.

📌 Educational Objective

Hearsay within hearsay (ie, double hearsay) is inadmissible unless both statements fall under a hearsay exclusion or hearsay exception.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 805 (hearsay within hearsay).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803–04 (hearsay exceptions).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801 (hearsay exclusions).
questions.zh-question:
原告是一名管理培训生，因其雇佣关系被不当终止而对雇主提起性别歧视诉讼。在庭审中，原告准备作证称，公司的一名清洁工告诉她，他听到她的主管对其他男同事谈论她时说：“给她点苦头吃。也许她就会回到她该待的地方去。”

原告拟提出的证词是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为清洁工的陈述是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为清洁工和主管的陈述都是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，因为清洁工的陈述属于“当时感官印象”，而主管的陈述属于其“当时存在的精神状态”的陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，因为清洁工和主管的陈述都是关于其雇佣范围内事项的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay within Hearsay
核心考点：双重传闻 (Double Hearsay) 当证词包含多层传闻时（A告诉B，B告诉C，C在法庭作证），每一层陈述都必须独立符合传闻例外或排除规则，否则整个证据不可采纳。
Reference: Fed. R. Evid. 805

本题考察的是证据链条的完整性。原告试图转述清洁工的话，而清洁工的话又是转述主管的话。我们需要逐层分析。

第一层 (Layer 1)
主管 (Supervisor) ➔ 清洁工
✔ 可采纳 (Admissible)
⬇
第二层 (Layer 2)
清洁工 (Janitor) ➔ 原告
✖ 不可采纳 (Inadmissible)
⬇
庭审 (Trial)
原告作证 (Plaintiff testifies)

法律分析 (Legal Analysis)

1. 第一层：主管的陈述
FRE 801(d)(2)(D) 主管说 "Make it hard for her..."。
这是对方当事人的代理人（Agent）作出的陈述。因为主管的职责包括管理员工，该陈述与其受雇范围 (Scope of Employment) 相关，且是用来指证雇主（被告）。
结论：这属于 Vicarious Admission（替代性自认），不是传闻（Hearsay Exclusion）。
2. 第二层：清洁工的陈述
FRE 801(d)(2)(D) Analysis 清洁工告诉原告 "I heard supervisor say..."。
虽然清洁工也是雇员，但关键在于：转述主管的性别歧视言论是否在清洁工的受雇范围内？
清洁工的职责通常是清洁和维护，不涉及人事管理或监督主管言行。因此，他在谈论与其工作职责无关的八卦（Gossip）。
结论：这不符合 Vicarious Admission 的要求。它属于普通传闻。
3. 是否有其他例外？
FRE 803(1) 当时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression)：要求陈述是在感知事件时或紧接着 (Immediately after) 作出的。
题目中没有证据表明清洁工是听到后“立刻”跑去告诉原告的。因此，选项 C 错误。
最终判决 由于第二层（清洁工对原告的陈述）是传闻且不符合任何例外，整个证词不可采纳。

正确答案是 选项 A。
💡 MBE 解题技巧 遇到 "Employee Statement"（雇员陈述）题型时，不要只看身份（是不是员工），必须检查 Scope of Employment（受雇范围）。
  • 卡车司机谈论自己发生的车祸 ➔ Within Scope
  • 清洁工谈论CEO的贪污或主管的歧视 ➔ 通常 Outside Scope (除非那是他工作的一部分)

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was prosecuted for murder of a man whose body was found one morning in the street near the defendant's house. The state calls a neighbor to testify that during the night before the body was found he heard the defendant's wife scream, "You killed him! You killed him!"
Is the neighbor's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it reports a privileged spousal communication.
choices.B: No, if the wife objects on spousal immunity grounds.
choices.C: Yes, as a report of a statement of belief.
choices.D: Yes, as a report of an excited utterance.

questions.explanation:
Reasoning for common hearsay exceptions
Exception Reason for reliability
  • Present sense impression
  • Excited utterance
 No time to fabricate statement
  • Past recollection recorded
 Records made when fresh in person's mind
  • Then-existing mental/physical condition
 Persons can perceive their own mental or physical state
  • Statement for medical diagnosis/treatment
 Self-interest creates motive for truth
  • Business & public records
  • Documents & statements on property interest
  • Certificates of birth, marriage, baptism
 Accuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation

Under the rule against hearsay, out-of-court statements are presumed unreliable and, therefore, are generally inadmissible when offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. However, certain out-of-court statements are excepted from this rule because they are inherently reliable. One such exception is excited utterances—ie, spontaneous statements that are:

  • related to a startling event or condition (regardless of the declarant's participation in that event) and
  • made while the declarant was still under stress from that event (ie, before the declarant could reflect on the event and fabricate the statement).

These requirements are assessed using multiple factors, including the content of the statement and the declarant's condition (eg, demeanor, vocal tone, physical condition).

Here, the state seeks to introduce the neighbor's testimony about the wife's out-of-court statement ("You killed him! You killed him!") to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (that the defendant killed the man). Although that statement is hearsay, it relates to a startling event (the man's death) and was made while the wife was still under stress (as evidenced by her repeated screams). Therefore, the neighbor's testimony is admissible as a report of an excited utterance.

(Choice A) Spousal communications are privileged if they are made during a valid marriage and reasonably intended to be confidential. But here, confidentiality was not intended since the woman screamed loudly enough for the neighbor to hear.

(Choice B) A criminal defendant's spouse may assert spousal immunity and refuse to testify against the criminal defendant. But this privilege would not apply here since the neighbor—not the defendant's wife—was called to testify.

(Choice C) A statement of a declarant's then-existing state of mind is a hearsay exception. But mere statements of belief or memory do not fall within this exception unless they relate to the declarant's will (not seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

Excited utterances—ie, spontaneous statements that (1) relate to a startling event and (2) were made while the declarant was still under stress from that event—are excepted from the hearsay rule.

📚 References
  • ⧉ Fed. R. Evid. 803(2) (excited utterance hearsay exception).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因谋杀罪被起诉，受害人是一名男子，其尸体于某日清晨在被告住所附近的街道上被发现。州政府传唤一位邻居作证，称在尸体被发现的前一晚，他听到被告的妻子尖叫：“你杀了他！你杀了他！”

该邻居的证词是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为它报告了一项受配偶通讯特权保护的通讯内容。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，如果妻子基于配偶豁免权的理由提出反对。
zh-choices.C: 可以，作为对一项信念陈述的报告。
zh-choices.D: 可以，作为对一项激动言辞的报告。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Hearsay Exceptions & Privileges
✅ 正确答案：D

可以采纳，作为对一项激动言辞 (Excited Utterance) 的报告。

核心考点：激动言辞例外
规则解析 (FRE 803(2))

虽然妻子的尖叫属于传闻证据 (Hearsay)，但根据联邦证据规则，如果陈述满足以下两个条件，则属于传闻例外，可以采纳：

  • 惊人事件：陈述与一个惊人的事件或状况有关 (Relating to a startling event)。
  • 压力之下：陈述是在陈述人仍处于该事件造成的兴奋或压力之下作出的 (Made while under the stress of excitement)。

本案应用：
1. 丈夫杀人（或被指控杀人）是一个惊人事件。
2. 妻子“尖叫” (screamed) 且重复喊叫，表明她当时处于极度的情绪压力之下，没有时间去捏造谎言。因此符合激动言辞的定义。

陷阱辨析：配偶特权为何不适用？

本题设计了两个关于配偶特权的干扰项（A和B），这是MBE常见的混淆点。

特权类型 配偶豁免权
Spousal Immunity		 配偶秘密通讯特权
Confidential Marital Communications
适用案件 仅限刑事案件 民事与刑事案件
关键要求 配偶一方被传唤作证 通讯必须具有保密性 (Confidentiality)
本题为何不适用 证人不是妻子，而是邻居。邻居没有豁免权。 妻子大声尖叫被邻居听到，破坏了保密性。
❌ 选项 A 错误：虽然这是夫妻间的对话，但因为妻子大声尖叫导致被第三人（邻居）听到，法律上视为当事人无意保密，因此失去了“秘密通讯特权”的保护。
❌ 选项 B 错误：配偶豁免权是指配偶可以拒绝上台作证。但这里上台作证的是邻居，妻子无法阻止邻居转述她听到的话（只要该话语符合传闻例外）。
❌ 选项 C 错误：“信念陈述” (Statement of belief) 通常不属于传闻例外（除非涉及遗嘱）。FRE 803(3) 允许“当时存在的精神状态”，但不允许用“对他人的信念”来证明过去发生的事实（即证明丈夫杀了人）。
💡 MBE 实战技巧

看到题目中有 "Screamed" (尖叫)、"Cried" (哭喊)、"Exclaimed" (惊呼) 或者句子末尾有感叹号 (!) 时，首先考虑 Excited Utterance。

法院认为处于极度兴奋或压力下的人没有时间编造谎言，因此这类证词具有固有的可靠性。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In an arson prosecution, the government seeks to rebut the defendant's alibi that he was in a jail in another state at the time of the fire. The government calls a witness to testify that he diligently searched through all the records of the jail and found no record of the defendant having been incarcerated there during the time the fire occurred.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the records themselves must be produced.
choices.C: Yes, as a summary of voluminous documents.
choices.D: Yes, as evidence of absence of an entry from a public record.

questions.explanation:
Hearsay exceptions for public records
Existing public
records
(FRE 803(8))		 Records or statements of public office/agency admissible if they set forth:
  • activities of office or agency
  • matters observed pursuant to legal duty (excluding police observations in criminal cases) OR
  • factual findings from legal investigation if offered in civil case or against government in criminal case
Absence of public
records
(FRE 803(10))		 Evidence that diligent search failed to locate public record or statement admissible if:
  • introduced through testimony or self-authenticating evidence certified under FRE 902 AND
  • in criminal cases, prosecutor gives written notice of intent to offer certification 14 days before trial & defendant does not object in writing within 7 days of receiving notice

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements (eg, a writing) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. One exception to this rule applies to the absence of public records, where evidence that a diligent search failed to locate a public record is admissible to prove that (1) a record does not exist OR (2) a matter regularly kept in public records did not occur. This evidence can be introduced through witness testimony or self-authenticating evidence certified under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 902.

Here, the witness seeks to testify that he diligently searched the jail records and found no record of the defendant being incarcerated at the time of the fire. Since incarceration is regularly recorded in public records, this witness testimony falls within the hearsay exception for the absence of public records (Choice A). As a result, it can be used to prove that the defendant's incarceration did not occur.

(Choice B) A party need not produce the records themselves to offer testimony that a search of public records failed to disclose a particular entry therein. Therefore, the failure to produce the records is not a basis to exclude the witness's testimony.

(Choice C) Under FRE 1006, a party may use a summary, chart, or calculation to prove the content of voluminous writings that are otherwise admissible. But this rule does not apply here because the witness is seeking to testify to the absence of an entry from the jail records—not to summarize those records.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the absence of public records hearsay exception, evidence that a diligent search failed to locate a public record is admissible to prove that (1) a record does not exist or (2) a matter regularly kept in public records did not occur.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(10) (hearsay exception for absent public records).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 902(1) (self-authenticating evidence).
questions.zh-question:
在一宗纵火案起诉中，政府试图反驳被告的不在场证明，即火灾发生时他正在另一州的监狱里。政府传唤一名证人作证，称他已尽职搜查了该监狱的所有记录，未发现被告在火灾发生期间曾被监禁于此的记录。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为这是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为必须出示记录本身。
zh-choices.C: 是，作为对大量文件的摘要。
zh-choices.D: 是，作为公共记录中无此条目的证据。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions
正确答案：D
本题考查的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）中的一个具体例外：公共记录的缺失 (Absence of Public Records)。
法律依据 (Legal Basis)
FRE 803(10) - Absence of a Public Record
为了证明：
  1. 某记录不存在 (the record does not exist)；或
  2. 某事项未曾发生 (a matter did not occur)；
如果该事项通常会被记录在公共记录中，那么关于“尽职搜查未能找到记录” (diligent search failed to disclose the record) 的证言是可采纳的。
案情分析 (Analysis)

在本案中，被告声称火灾发生时他在另一州的监狱里（不在场证明）。政府为了反驳这一点，传唤证人作证称：

  • 他进行了尽职搜查 (diligently searched)；
  • 搜查对象是监狱记录（属于 Public Records）；
  • 结果是未发现记录 (found no record)。

虽然这在技术上属于利用“庭外陈述/行为”（搜查结果）来证明事实真相（被告不在监狱），但这完全符合 FRE 803(10) 的例外规定。因此，该证言可以用来证明被告当时并未被监禁。

为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误：
虽然这确实涉及传闻（Hearsay），但它明确属于 FRE 803(10) 的例外 (Exception)，因此并非不可采纳。
选项 B 错误 (Best Evidence Rule 陷阱)：
最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule) 要求在证明文件内容时出示原件。但在这里，证人是在证明记录不存在 (absence)，而不是证明某个具体文件的内容。既然记录不存在，就无法“出示”记录。因此，证言本身就是最佳证据。
选项 C 错误 (Summaries 陷阱)：
FRE 1006 允许使用摘要 (Summaries) 来呈现大量现存文件 (voluminous writings)。本案中证人并非在总结成堆的文件，而是在证明某条特定记录的缺失。
💡 MBE 实战技巧
当你在题干中看到“Diligent Search” (尽职搜查) 和 “Found No Record” (未发现记录) 这两个关键词组合时，请立即联想 FRE 803(10)。

区分点：
  • 如果是证明记录里有什么 → 考虑 Public Records Exception (FRE 803(8))。
  • 如果是证明记录里没有什么 → 考虑 Absence of Public Record (FRE 803(10))。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for copyright infringement because the defendant's book contained some slightly disguised house plans on which the plaintiff held the copyright. The plaintiff is prepared to testify that he heard the defendant's executive assistant for copyright matters say that the defendant had obtained an advance copy of the plans from the plaintiff's office manager. The defendant's attorney objects.
How should the court rule on the admissibility of the plaintiff's testimony?

choices.A: The testimony is admissible as a statement of a coconspirator.
choices.B: The testimony is admissible as a statement of an employee of a party-opponent.
choices.C: The testimony is inadmissible, because it is hearsay not within any exception
choices.D: The testimony is inadmissible, because there is no showing that the assistant was authorized to speak for the defendant.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements by party-opponent

The rule against hearsay generally bars the admission of out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. However, some statements are excludedExcluded StatementStatements defined as nonhearsay under FRE 801(d) (e.g., party-opponent admissions and prior statements of witnesses).传闻证据的排除：指根据联邦证据规则第801(d)条，不属于传闻的陈述（如对方当事人的承认或证人先前的陈述）。 from the rule (ie, are nonhearsay) and can be offered for their asserted truth. This includes out-of-court statements offered against a party-opponent that were:

  • made or adopted by the party-opponent
  • made by a person authorized by the party-opponent to make a statement on the subject
  • made by the party-opponent's agent or employee about a matter within the scope of that agency or employment relationship or
  • made by the party-opponent's coconspirator during and in furtherance of the conspiracy.

Here, the plaintiff seeks to testify against the defendant (party-opponent) about an out-of-court statement made by the defendant's executive assistant for copyright matters (employee). This statement asserts that the defendant had obtained an advance copy of the plaintiff's house plans—a copyright matter within the scope of the assistant's employment. As a result, the plaintiff's testimony is admissible as a statement of a party-opponent's employee (Choices A & D).

(Choice C) Since the assistant's out-of-court statement constitutes nonhearsay, it does not require a hearsay exceptionHearsay ExceptionAn exception that allows an out-of-court statement to be admitted for its truth despite the general rule against hearsay (e.g., excited utterances, business records).传闻证据的例外：指即使是传闻证据，但在符合特定例外情形（如激动陈述、商业记录等）时仍可被采信。 to be admissible.

📌 Educational Objective

An out-of-court statement offered against a party-opponent for its truth is nonhearsay if it was (1) made or adopted by the party-opponent, (2) made by a person the party-opponent authorized to make such a statement, (3) made by the party-opponent's agent or employee about a matter within the scope of that relationship, or (4) made by the party-opponent's coconspirator during and in furtherance of the conspiracy.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (nonhearsay statements by party-opponent).
questions.zh-question:
原告因被告的书籍中包含一些经过轻微伪装的、原告拥有版权的房屋平面图，而对被告提起了版权侵权诉讼。原告准备作证，称其听到被告负责版权事务的行政助理说，被告从原告的办公室经理处获得了该平面图的预发副本。被告的律师提出反对。

法院应如何裁定原告证词的可采性？

zh-choices.A: 该证词可采，因为它是同谋者的陈述。
zh-choices.B: 该证词可采，因为它是对方当事人雇员的陈述。
zh-choices.C: 该证词不可采，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.D: 该证词不可采，因为没有证据表明该助理被授权代表被告发言。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exemptions
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule) Federal Rules of Evidence 801(d)(2)(D)
对方当事人的陈述 (Opposing Party's Statement) 被定义为非传闻证据 (Nonhearsay)。

如果陈述是由对方当事人的代理人或雇员 (Agent or Employee) 作出的，且满足以下条件，则可采：
  • 陈述是在雇佣关系存续期间作出的；且
  • 陈述内容涉及其雇佣/职责范围 (Scope of Employment) 内的事项。

🔍 案情逻辑分析

1. 识别陈述人 (Declarant):
陈述人是被告的“负责版权事务的行政助理” (Executive Assistant for Copyright Matters)。这确认了其雇员身份。
2. 判定职责范围 (Scope):
该助理的头衔明确指出其负责“版权事务”。陈述的内容是关于“被告如何获得房屋平面图（版权对象）”。
因此，该陈述完全在她的职责范围 (Scope of Employment) 之内。
3. 结论 (Conclusion):
原告（Plaintiff）将该陈述用于反对被告（Defendant）。符合 FRE 801(d)(2)(D) 的所有要素。因此，该证词作为对方当事人雇员的陈述 (Statement of an employee of a party-opponent) 是可采的。
⚠️ 常见陷阱：授权 (Authorization)

选项 D 是本题最大的干扰项。

很多考生误以为雇员必须被“明确授权代表公司发言” (Authorized to speak) 才能使证词可采。这是旧的普通法规则或适用于 FRE 801(d)(2)(C) 的情况。

在现代联邦证据规则 (FRE 801(d)(2)(D)) 下，不需要证明雇员有“发言权”。只要陈述内容与其工作职责相关 (Relates to a matter within the scope)，即视为公司的替代性自认 (Vicarious Admission)。

其他选项解析：
  • 选项 A (Coconspirator): 错误。虽然同谋者陈述也是非传闻，但本案是版权侵权，没有涉及共谋 (Conspiracy) 的事实基础。
  • 选项 C (Hearsay): 错误。根据 FRE 801(d)，这类陈述被定义为“非传闻” (Nonhearsay)，而不是传闻的例外 (Exception)。虽然结果都是可采，但法律定性不同。
MBE Evidence Strategy: Focus on the relationship and the topic, not the permission to speak.

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for theft of a used car that he took for a test drive and did not return. He was arrested in the car two days later. In his defense, the defendant has testified that he had no intention of keeping the car but got caught up in marital problems and simply delayed returning it. The defendant calls a witness to testify that the defendant told him, during the two days, "I'm going to return this car as soon as I work things out with my wife."
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is a self-serving statement by an accused.
choices.B: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.C: Yes, as a prior consistent statement of the defendant.
choices.D: Yes, as a statement by the defendant of his then-existing state of mind.

questions.explanation:
Admissibility of out-of-court statements
= Admissible
= Inadmissible

Under the rule against hearsay, testimony regarding an out-of-court statement is generally inadmissible to prove the truth of the matter asserted in that statement. But such testimony is admissible if the statement falls under an exceptionHearsay Exception / 传闻例外An exception that allows an out-of-court statement to be admitted for its truth despite the general rule against hearsay. to the hearsay rule. One hearsay exception applies to statements concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mindThen-Existing State of Mind / 当时存在的心境A hearsay exception for statements showing the declarant's mental, emotional, or physical condition at the time the statement was made. (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health).

Here, the witness seeks to testify that the defendant told him, "I'm going to return this car as soon as I work things out with my wife." This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted—ie, that the defendant intended to return the car once he dealt with his marital issues. But since the statement concerns the defendant's intent, it is admissible under the then-existing state of mind exception to the rule against hearsay (Choice D).

(Choice A) Statements by a party-opponent are excludedExcluded Statement / 排除的陈述Statements defined as nonhearsay under FRE 801(d) (e.g., party-opponent admissions and prior statement of witness). from the hearsay rule (ie, nonhearsay) if the statement is offered against that party. And though this does not apply to self-serving statements that favor the party-opponent, those statements may still be admissible if they fall under a hearsay exception (as seen here).

(Choice C) A witness's out-of-court statement is nonhearsay if it is (1) consistent with the witness's present testimony and (2) used to support the witness's credibility after it has been attacked. The defendant's statement does not fall under this hearsay exclusion because there is no indication that his credibility has been attacked.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements regarding a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health) are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception for a declarant's then-existing state of mind).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因偷窃一辆二手车而受审，他将车开去试驾后未归还。两天后，他在车内被捕。被告为自己辩护时作证说，他无意占有该车，只是因为陷入了婚姻问题而推迟了还车时间。被告传唤一名证人作证，证明被告在这两天内曾对他说：“等我处理好和我妻子的问题，我马上就去还这辆车。”

该证人的证词是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为这是被告作出的自利性陈述。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为这是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为这属于被告的先前一致性陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为这属于被告关于其当时心智状态的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - Hearsay Exceptions
正确答案：选项 D
(Yes, as a statement by the defendant of his then-existing state of mind.)
⚖️ 法律规则：当时心智状态例外

Rule: FRE 803(3) Then-Existing Mental, Emotional, or Physical Condition

虽然传闻证据（Hearsay）通常不可采纳，但如果陈述是关于陈述人（Declarant）当时的心智状态（如动机、意图、计划）或情绪/身体状况，则属于例外，可以采纳。

关键点：这种陈述可以用来证明陈述人确实持有该意图，并可能据此采取了后续行动（或未采取行动）。

🔍 案情分析
1. 证据定性：
被告对证人说：“等我处理好和我妻子的问题，我马上就去还这辆车。”
这是一个庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)，且被告试图用它来证明陈述内容的真实性（即他真的打算还车，而非偷车）。因此，这是传闻证据 (Hearsay)。
2. 为什么可以采纳？
偷窃罪 (Theft) 通常需要证明被告有“永久剥夺他人财产的意图” (Intent to permanently deprive)。
被告的这句话表明了他当时的意图 (Then-existing intent) 是归还车辆，而非永久占有。这直接否定了偷窃罪所需的犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)。根据 FRE 803(3)，这是关于当前意图的陈述，属于传闻例外，因此可以采纳。
🚫 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (Self-serving statement) 错误。 “自利性陈述” (Self-serving) 本身并不是联邦证据规则 (FRE) 中排除证据的理由。虽然普通法时代常以此为由排除证据，但在现代规则下，只要该陈述符合传闻例外（如本题中的 State of Mind），即使对被告有利（自利），也是可以采纳的。
选项 C (Prior Consistent Statement) 错误。 “先前一致性陈述” (FRE 801(d)(1)(B)) 只有在证人的可信度受到“最近捏造” (Recent fabrication) 或“不当影响” (Improper influence) 的指控之后，才能用来反驳这些指控。题目中没有提到检方攻击了被告证词的可信度，因此不能适用此排除规则。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

区分 Party-Opponent Admission 与 State of Mind：

  • 如果陈述是被告说的，且由检方（对手）提出用来攻击被告 ➡️ Non-hearsay (Party-Opponent Admission)。
  • 如果陈述是被告说的，且由被告自己提出（为了证明自己当时的意图/清白） ➡️ Hearsay Exception (State of Mind)。

本题是被告自己传唤证人，属于第二种情况。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a civil trial for professional malpractice, the plaintiff sought to show that the defendant, an engineer, had designed the plaintiff's flour mill with inadequate power. The plaintiff called an expert witness who based his testimony solely on his own professional experience but also asserted, when asked, that a certain book on milling systems was a reliable treatise in the field and consistent with his views.
On cross-examination, the defendant asked the witness whether he and the treatise were ever wrong. The witness answered, "Nobody's perfect." The defendant asked no further questions. The defendant later called his own expert witness and asked, "Do you accept the book on milling systems as reliable?" The witness said, "It once was, but it is now badly out of date." The plaintiff requested that the jury be allowed to examine the book and judge for itself the book's reliability.
Should the court allow the jury to examine the book?

choices.A: No, because the jury may consider only passages read to it by counsel or by a witness.
choices.B: No, because the plaintiff's expert did not rely on the treatise in his testimony but on his own experience.
choices.C: Yes, because an expert has testified that the treatise is reliable.
choices.D: Yes, because the jury is the judge of the weight and credibility to be accorded both written and oral evidence.

questions.explanation:
An out-of-court statement is hearsayHearsay / 传闻证据An out-of-court statement offered in court to prove the truth of the matter asserted. when offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. Such statements are generally inadmissible. However, statements in a learned treatise, periodical, or pamphlet are excepted from the rule against hearsay and are admissible for their truth when:

  • the statements are called to the attention of, or relied on by, an expert witnessExpert Witness / 专家证人A witness who is qualified as an expert by knowledge, skill, experience, training, or education. during examination and
  • and
  • the publication is established as a reasonably reliable authority by a party's expert or by judicial noticeJudicial Notice / 司法认知A rule in the law of evidence that allows a fact to be introduced into evidence if the truth of that fact is so notorious or well known, or so authoritatively attested, that it cannot reasonably be doubted..

Expert testimony that a treatise is a reliable authority lays a foundation for admitting the statements therein. But those statements may only be read into evidence, so the treatise itself may not be offered as an exhibit.

Here, the plaintiff's expert witness asserted, when asked on direct examination, that the book on milling systems was a reliable treatise in the field. And though the expert did not rely on the treatise in his testimony but on his own experience, his assertion is sufficient to establish it as reliable and admissible under the learned treatiseLearned Treatise / 学术著作或期刊A publication that is established as a reliable authority in a particular field, such as a textbook, journal, or treatise. hearsay exception (Choice B). But since the jury may only consider passages read to it by counsel or a witness, the court may not allow the jury to examine the book itself (Choice C).

(Choice D) A jury assesses the weight and credibility of evidence only after it has been admitted. And here, the jury may not examine the book itself because it is inadmissible.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements in a publication (eg, learned treatise) may be read into evidence if they are (1) called to the attention of, or relied on by, an expert witness during examination and (2) the publication is established as a reliable authority by any party's expert or by judicial notice. However, the publication itself may not be offered as an exhibit.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(18) (hearsay exception – statements in learned treatises).
questions.zh-question:
在一起关于职业过失的民事审判中，原告试图证明被告（一名工程师）设计的原告面粉厂功率不足。原告传唤了一名专家证人，该证人的证词完全基于其个人专业经验，但在被问及时，他也声称一本关于碾磨系统的书籍是该领域内一本可靠的学术专著，且与他的观点一致。

在交叉询问中，被告问证人他本人和那本学术专著是否曾出过错。证人回答说：“人无完人。”被告没有再提问。之后，被告传唤了自己的专家证人，并问道：“您认为那本关于碾磨系统的书籍可靠吗？”该证人说：“曾经可靠，但现在已经严重过时了。”原告请求允许陪审团检查该书，并自行判断其可靠性。

法院是否应允许陪审团检查该书？

zh-choices.A: 不应允许，因为陪审团只能审阅由律师或证人向其宣读的段落。
zh-choices.B: 不应允许，因为原告的专家证人在其证词中并未依赖该学术专著，而是依赖其个人经验。
zh-choices.C: 应允许，因为一名专家已作证该学术专著是可靠的。
zh-choices.D: 应允许，因为陪审团是赋予书面证据和口头证据的证据力和可信度的裁定者。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 证据法考点解析

学术专著例外 (Learned Treatise Exception)

本题考察的是美国联邦证据规则（FRE）中关于传闻证据（Hearsay）的一个重要例外：学术专著（Learned Treatises）的使用规则。

⚖️ 核心法律规则：FRE 803(18)

学术专著、期刊或小册子中的陈述可以作为实质证据（Substantive Evidence）被采纳，但必须满足以下条件：

  1. 基础 (Foundation)：该出版物必须被专家证人或司法认知（Judicial Notice）确立为该领域的可靠权威 (Reliable Authority)。
  2. 关联 (Nexus)：在专家证人的直接询问中被依赖，或在交叉询问中被提请注意。
  3. ⚠️ 关键限制 (Limitation)：相关段落可以宣读 (Read into evidence) 给陪审团听，但该出版物本身不得作为物证 (Exhibit) 提交给陪审团带入评议室。

📝 案情分析

在本案中：

  • 原告专家虽然主要依赖个人经验，但承认该书是“可靠的学术专著”。这已经满足了可靠性基础的要求。
  • 原告请求让陪审团检查 (Examine) 该书并自行判断。

考点判断： 尽管书的内容具有可采性（Admissible），但根据 FRE 803(18) 的特殊程序规定，陪审团不能亲自翻阅书籍。这是为了防止外行陪审员在没有专家指导的情况下，断章取义或误解书中的技术性内容。

✅ 选项解析

选项 A (正确) 不应允许，因为陪审团只能审阅由律师或证人向其宣读的段落。

这准确陈述了 FRE 803(18) 的限制规则。书中的内容是证据，但书这个“物体”不能进入陪审团室。

选项 B (错误)

错误理由： 规则并不要求专家必须在证词中“依赖”该书。只要专家承认该书是可靠权威，或者在交叉询问中被提请注意即可。本案中专家已承认其可靠性。

选项 C (错误)

错误理由： 虽然专家证实了书的可靠性，但这只解决了“内容可采性”问题，没有解决“展示方式”的问题。规则明确禁止将书作为物证提交。

选项 D (错误)

错误理由： 这是一个干扰项。虽然陪审团确实负责衡量证据权重，但他们必须依照证据规则来接触证据。程序性规则（FRE 803(18)）优先于陪审团的一般职能。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据法题目中，看到 "Learned Treatise" (学术专著) 时，请立即联想两个关键词：

  1. Reliable Authority (可靠权威) - 必须有人背书。
  2. Read, don't Show (只读不看) - 只能读给陪审团听，不能把书给他们。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a civil action for misrepresentation in the sale of real estate, the parties contested whether the defendant was licensed by a public agency established by statute to license real estate brokers. The defendant testified that she was licensed. On rebuttal, the plaintiff has offered a certification, bearing the seal of the secretary of the public agency. The certification states that the secretary conducted a thorough search of the agency's records and all relevant databases, and that this search uncovered no record of a license ever having been issued to the defendant. The certification is signed by the secretary.
Is the certification that there is no record of a license having been issued to the defendant admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the writing was not properly authenticated.
choices.C: Yes, for the limited purpose of impeaching the defendant.
choices.D: Yes, to prove the nonexistence of a public record.

questions.explanation:
Hearsay exceptions for public records
Existing public records
(FRE 803(8)) 		Records or statements of public office/agency admissible if they set forth:
  • activities of office or agency
  • matters observed pursuant to legal duty (excluding police observations in criminal cases) OR
  • factual findings from legal investigation if offered in civil case or against government in criminal case
Absence of public records
(FRE 803(10)) 		Evidence that diligent search failed to locate public record or statement admissible if:
  • introduced through testimony or self-authenticating evidence自认证证据 (无需额外证明真实性即可直接接纳的证据) certified under FRE 902 AND
  • in criminal cases, prosecutor gives written notice of intent to offer certification 14 days before trial & defendant does not object in writing within 7 days of receiving notice
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. These statements are inadmissible unless they fall within an exception to the hearsay rule. One exception applies to existing public records. Another exception applies to the absence of public records, which allows the admission of evidence that a diligent search failed to locate a public record to prove that:

  • the public record does not exist or
  • a matter regularly kept in public records did not occur.

But this evidence must be admitted through witness testimony or self-authenticating evidence自认证证据 (无需额外证明真实性即可直接接纳的证据) certified under Federal Rule of Evidence 902—eg, a signed and sealed document from a public agency.

Here, the plaintiff has offered a certification to show that a thorough search of the agency's records uncovered no record of a license having been issued to the defendant. And since the certification has the agency's seal and the secretary's signature, it is self-authenticating evidence自认证证据 (无需额外证明真实性即可直接接纳的证据). As a result, it is admissible under the absence of public records exception to prove the nonexistence of the defendant's license (Choice A).

(Choice B) Domestic public documents bearing a government seal and signature attesting to their truth are self-authenticating自认证的 (无需额外证明真实性即可直接接纳). Therefore, no other evidence was needed to authenticate认证 / 鉴真 (证明证据是其所声称之物的过程) the certification here.

(Choice C) The certification is admissible to impeach弹劾 (指控或挑战证人可信度的行为) the defendant's testimony. But since the certification is excepted from the rule against hearsay, it is also admissible to prove that the defendant did not have a real estate license.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the absence of public records exception, evidence that a diligent search failed to locate a public record is admissible to prove that (1) the public record does not exist or (2) a matter regularly kept in public records did not occur. However, this evidence can only be admitted through witness testimony or self-authenticating evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(10) (hearsay exception for absent public records).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 902(1) (self-authenticating evidence).
questions.zh-question:
在一起关于房地产销售中虚假陈述的民事诉讼中，双方就被告是否持有由法律设立、负责为房地产经纪人颁发执照的公共机构所颁发的执照存在争议。被告作证称她持有执照。在反驳环节，原告提供了一份证明，该证明盖有该公共机构秘书的印章。证明中陈述，该秘书对机构的记录及所有相关数据库进行了彻底搜查，未发现任何曾向被告颁发过执照的记录。该证明由秘书签署。

这份关于未曾向被告颁发执照记录的证明，是否可采纳为证据？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为这是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该书面文件未经适当认证。
zh-choices.C: 是，但其目的仅限于弹劾被告的证词。
zh-choices.D: 是，用以证明公共记录不存在。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析
证据法：公共记录的缺失

正确答案：D

是，用以证明公共记录不存在。

Yes, to prove the nonexistence of a public record.

⚖️ 核心考点：FRE 803(10)

公共记录缺失的例外 (Absence of a Public Record)

虽然这属于传闻证据 (Hearsay)，但《联邦证据规则》(FRE) 803(10) 规定了一个例外。如果满足以下条件，证明某记录不存在的证据是可采纳的：

  • 证据表明进行了尽职搜查 (Diligent search)；且
  • 未能找到记录。

该证据通常用于证明：

  1. 该记录不存在；或
  2. 通常会被记录的事项没有发生。
🔍 题目解析逻辑
1. 传闻证据的本质 (Hearsay Nature)
原告提供的“证明书”是一份庭外陈述，目的是为了证明其内容（即被告没有执照）的真实性。原则上这是传闻。
2. 适用例外 (Applying the Exception)
根据 FRE 803(10)，为了证明公共记录不存在，可以引入一份证明书。本案中，证明书声明秘书进行了“彻底搜查” (thorough search) 且未发现记录，完全符合规则要求。
3. 自我认证 (Self-Authentication)
根据 FRE 902(1)，带有政府印章 (Seal) 和官员签名 (Signature) 的国内公共文件是自我认证的 (Self-authenticating)。
题目中明确提到该证明带有“印章” (Seal) 和“签名” (Signed)，因此不需要传唤保管员出庭作证来认证文件。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (Hearsay) 错误：
虽然它是传闻，但它完全符合 FRE 803(10) 的传闻例外。既然符合例外，就是可采纳的。
选项 B (Authentication) 错误：
该文件带有公章和签名，属于 FRE 902 下的自证文件 (Self-authenticating document)，无需外部证人进行认证。
选项 C (Impeachment) 错误：
这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然该证据确实可以用来弹劾 (Impeach) 被告的信誉，但由于它符合传闻例外，它也可以作为实质性证据 (Substantive Evidence) 来证明“被告确实没有执照”这一事实，而不仅仅是用来攻击被告的可信度。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

区分“弹劾”与“实质证据”：

在 MBE 中，如果一个证据符合传闻例外 (Hearsay Exception)，它通常既可以用于弹劾，也可以用于证明事实真相 (Substantive use)。

如果选项限制用途为“仅限弹劾” (Limited purpose of impeachment)，通常是错误的，除非该陈述不符合任何传闻例外（例如仅仅是先前的非宣誓不一致陈述）。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was indicted for engaging in a fraudulent investment scheme. At the criminal trial, the prosecutor called a witness who had participated in the scheme with the defendant. The witness testified about the operation of the scheme and was cross-examined by the defendant's attorney. The case resulted in a mistrial.
An investor who was allegedly defrauded by the scheme has now brought a civil action against the defendant. She seeks to introduce the witness's testimony from the criminal trial. The witness has moved to a foreign country.
Is the witness's testimony in the criminal trial admissible in the civil action?

choices.A: No, because the burden of proof in a criminal action is different from the burden of proof in a civil action.
choices.B: No, because the parties are not identical in the two actions.
choices.C: Yes, because it is prior testimony of an unavailable declarant.
choices.D: Yes, but only if the investor demonstrates that she was unable to obtain the witness's attendance by subpoena or other reasonable means.

questions.explanation:
Unavailable declarant
(FRE 804(a))

Declarant is unavailable as witness if declarant:

  • is exempted from testifying by privilege
  • refuses to testify
  • has lapse of memory
  • is dead or ill
  • is absent from trial or hearing & proponent could not obtain attendance or testimony by subpoena or other reasonable means
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is a statement made outside the present proceeding that is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But an exception to the rule against hearsay applies to a declarant's former testimonyFormer Testimony / 先前证言Testimony given by a witness at a prior trial, hearing, or deposition, which is admissible under a hearsay exception if the witness is now unavailable and the opposing party had an opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine. if:

  • the testimony was given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the current case or a different proceeding that involved similar parties and issues
  • the party against whom the testimony is offered had an opportunity and similar motive to develop that testimony through direct or cross-examination of the declarant and
  • the declarant is unavailable as a witness.

A declarant is unavailableUnavailable / 无法出庭A status under FRE 804(a) where a declarant cannot testify due to privilege, refusal, memory lapse, death/illness, or absence despite reasonable means to procure attendance. if (1) he/she is absent from the trial or hearing and (2) the proponent could not obtain the declarant's attendance by subpoena or other reasonable means.

Here, the investor seeks to introduce the witness's testimony from the defendant's criminal fraud trial in the civil fraud action against the defendant (similar parties and issues). That former testimony is being introduced against the defendant, whose attorney cross-examined the witness in the criminal case. And though the witness is absent from the civil trial (in foreign country), the witness's former testimony is only admissible if the investor also shows that she could not obtain the witness's attendance by subpoena or other reasonable means (Choice C).

(Choice A) The burden of proofBurden of Proof / 证明责任The obligation of a party in a trial to produce the evidence that will prove the claims they have made against the other party. in a criminal action is different from the burden of proof in a civil action. But this has no bearing on the admissibility of the former testimony of an unavailable declarant.

(Choice B) The parties need not be identical in the two actions for the former testimony of an unavailable declarant to be admissible.

📌 Educational Objective

A declarant's former testimony is admissible if (1) the testimony was given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the same case or a different proceeding that involved similar parties and issues, (2) the party against whom the testimony is offered had an opportunity and similar motive to develop that testimony through examination of the declarant, and (3) the declarant is unavailable.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(1) (hearsay exception – former testimony).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因参与欺诈性投资计划而被起诉。在刑事审判中，检察官传唤了一名曾与被告一同参与该计划的证人。该证人就该计划的运作方式作证，并接受了被告律师的交叉询问。该案最终因审判无效而告终。

一名声称被该计划欺诈的投资者现已对该被告提起民事诉讼。她试图引入该证人在刑事审判中的证词。该证人已移居国外。

该证人在刑事审判中的证词在民事诉讼中是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为刑事诉讼的证明责任与民事诉讼的证明责任不同。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为两起诉讼的当事人不完全相同。
zh-choices.C: 可以，但前提是该投资者证明她无法通过庭外取证（deposition）的方式获得该证人的证词。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为这是无法出庭的陈述人的先前证词。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Former Testimony Exception

本题考察的是证据法中的核心难点：传闻证据的例外——先前证词。

⚖️ 法律规则 (FRE 804(b)(1))

当陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailable) 时，其在之前的审判、听证或庭外取证中作出的先前证词 (Former Testimony) 可被采纳，前提是：

该证据是用来针对同一方（在民事案件中也可以是其利益前手），且该方在之前的程序中有机会 (Opportunity) 和相似的动机 (Similar Motive) 对该证人进行询问。

📝 案例逻辑分析

1
证人是否“无法出庭”？
Is the declarant unavailable?

是。 题目指出证人已移居国外 (moved to a foreign country)。根据 FRE 804(a)，如果陈述人缺席且无法通过合理手段获取其出庭，即视为“无法出庭”。

2
是否有“先前证词”？
Is there former testimony?

是。 证人在之前的刑事审判 (Criminal Trial) 中宣誓作证。

3
关键测试：机会与动机
Opportunity and Similar Motive
  • 针对谁使用？ 针对被告 (Defendant)。
  • 被告之前在场吗？ 在场。
  • 被告有过机会吗？ 有，被告律师进行了交叉询问 (Cross-examined)。
  • 动机是否相似？ 是。虽然一个是刑事一个是民事，但核心事实都是关于“欺诈性投资计划”的运作。被告在两案中都有极强的动机去质疑证人关于欺诈细节的描述，以避免定罪或赔偿。

因此，选项 D 正确。这完全符合“无法出庭陈述人的先前证词”这一传闻例外。

🚫 常见陷阱 (Distractors)

选项 B (当事人不完全相同) 为什么错？

这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。规则不要求两起诉讼的双方当事人完全一致 (Identical Parties)。

规则只要求证据所针对的一方 (The party against whom the testimony is now offered) 必须在之前的诉讼中有机会和动机进行质询。

在本案中：
前案：政府 vs. 被告
本案：投资者 vs. 被告
虽然原告变了，但证据都是用来针对被告的，而被告在两次都有机会辩护。这就足够了。

关于选项 A： 证明责任 (Burden of Proof) 的不同（刑事的“排除合理怀疑” vs 民事的“优势证据”）不影响证据本身的可采性 (Admissibility)。

关于选项 C： 这是一个过度具体的错误选项。虽然无法获取证词是判断“无法出庭”的因素之一，但题目已经给出了证人移居国外这一强有力的无法出庭理由，选项 D 提供了更准确的法律依据。

MBE Evidence Review | © 2025 Exam Prep

label.zh: 证人无法出庭的证明要求

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A man was charged with the armed robbery of a convenience store and pleaded not guilty. At trial, the man testified on direct examination that he had never been inside the store that was robbed. Intending the man to testify that he told police the same, the man's attorney then asked, "What, if anything, did you tell the police when you were arrested?" The prosecutor has objected.
Is the intended testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the man has a substantial motive to fabricate his testimony that he had never been inside the store.
choices.B: No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.C: Yes, because the statement to police was made before the man had a motive to fabricate his testimony.
choices.D: Yes, to prove that the man had never been inside the store.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements by declarant-witness
(FRE 801(d)(1))
Prior statement of identification
  • Identifies person as someone declarant perceived earlier
Prior inconsistent statement
  • Inconsistent with declarant's current testimony and
  • made under penalty of perjury at former proceeding
Prior consistent statement
  • Consistent with declarant's current testimony and offered to either:
    • rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence if made before motive arose
    • or
    • rehabilitate declarant's credibility when attacked on other grounds
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

HearsayHearsay / 传闻证据An out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, which is generally inadmissible unless an exception or exclusion applies. refers to out-of-court statements (here, the man's statement to police) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (that he had never been inside the store). Such statements are inadmissible unless specifically excluded or exceptedExcluded or Excepted / 排除或例外Excluded statements (non-hearsay under FRE 801(d)) and excepted statements (hearsay exceptions under FRE 803/804) are admissible despite the general rule against hearsay. from the rule against hearsay. One hearsay exclusionHearsay Exclusion / 传闻证据排除Under the Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE 801(d)), certain statements are defined as non-hearsay (exempt from the hearsay rule) rather than being admitted under an exception. applies when the declarant is on the witness stand and an out-of-court statement that is consistent with the declarant-witness's current testimony is offered to:

  • rebut a charge of fabrication or improper influence, if the out-of-court statement was made before a motive for the alleged fabrication or improper influence arose or
  • rehabilitate the declarant-witness's credibility when attacked on other grounds.

Here, the man's prior statement to police is consistent with his current testimony, but it was not offered to rehabilitate the man's credibility. Nor was it offered to rebut a charge of fabrication or improper influence.* And even if it had, the statement was made after the man had a motive to fabricate (i.e., after his arrest) (Choice C). Therefore, it does not meet the criteria for admission as a prior consistent statement. And since no other hearsay exclusion or exception applies, the man's intended testimony is not admissible.

*Additionally, the hearsay exclusion for statements by a party-opponentStatement by an Opposing Party / 对手当事人陈述Under FRE 801(d)(2), a statement offered against an opposing party that was made by that party is non-hearsay. does not apply. Although the man is a party to the case (the defendant), his statement is not being offered against him by his opponent (the prosecution).

(Choice A) The man may have a substantial motive to fabricate his testimony because he has been accused of a crime. That motive does not provide a basis to exclude otherwise admissible testimony but may be used by the prosecution to impeachImpeach / 弹劾证人To challenge the credibility of a witness by presenting evidence of inconsistency, bias, or character for untruthfulness. the man by attacking his credibility as a witness.

(Choice D) The man's intended testimony cannot be admitted to prove that he had never been inside the store because it is hearsay not within any exception.

📌 Educational Objective

A declarant-witness's prior consistent statement is excluded from the rule against hearsay if (1) it is offered to rebut a charge of fabrication/improper influence and was made before a motive to fabricate arose or (2) it is offered to rehabilitate the witness's credibility.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(1)(B) (declarant-witness's prior consistent statement)
questions.zh-question:
一名男子被控告持械抢劫一家便利店，并作了无罪辩护。在庭审中，该男子在直接询问时作证称，他从未进入过被抢劫的那家商店。随后，该男子的律师意图让其证明他也对警察说了同样的话，于是问道：“在您被捕时，您对警察说了些什么（如果有的话）？”检察官对此提出了反对。

该预期的证言是否可被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该男子有重大的动机去捏造其证词。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该证言是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。
zh-choices.C: 是，作为先前的一致性陈述。
zh-choices.D: 是，用以证明该男子从未进入过该商店。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - Hearsay (传闻证据)

核心考点：传闻证据与增信 (Bolstering)

本题考察的是联邦证据规则 (FRE) 801 关于传闻证据的定义以及“先前一致性陈述” (Prior Consistent Statement) 的适用条件。

关键事实：

  • 被告在直接询问 (Direct Examination) 阶段作证。
  • 被告试图引入自己之前对警察说的“我没进过那家店”的陈述。
  • 目的：证明他当时说的话和现在一样（即他是诚实的）。

正确答案解析：选项 B

结论：该证言不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据且不符合任何例外。

法律依据：

  1. 传闻证据 (Hearsay)： 被告在庭外（被捕时）所做的陈述，现在在庭上提出，目的是为了证明该陈述内容的真实性（即他确实没进过商店）。这符合 FRE 801(c) 的传闻定义。
  2. 自我增信 (Bolstering) 禁止： 一般规则是，证人不能通过引入先前的陈述来通过“自我印证”提升自己的可信度。
  3. 例外不适用： 虽然 FRE 801(d)(1)(B) 允许引入“先前一致性陈述”，但有一个严格的前提条件：必须是为了反驳关于“近期捏造” (Recent Fabrication) 或“不正当动机” (Improper Motive) 的指控。

本案分析： 此时正处于直接询问阶段，检察官尚未进行交叉询问 (Cross-Examination)，也没有指控被告在撒谎或有不良动机。因此，引入先前一致性陈述为时过早 (Premature)，仅仅属于不可采纳的传闻。

陷阱选项分析：选项 C

错误原因： 选项 C 认为是“先前一致性陈述”所以可采纳。这是 MBE 中最常见的陷阱之一。

区分关键：

  • 仅仅“一致”是不够的。 法律不允许证人仅仅因为“我以前也这么说过”来证明自己现在说的是真话。
  • 触发条件 (Trigger)： 只有当证人的可信度受到特定类型的攻击（如被指控最近才编造谎言）后，先前一致性陈述才可作为恢复名誉 (Rehabilitation) 的手段被引入。

其他选项简析

  • 选项 A (错误)： 证人有“捏造动机”是对方律师在交叉询问时用来弹劾 (Impeach) 证人的理由，而不是法官在直接询问时排除证词的理由。动机影响的是证据的分量 (Weight)，而非可采性 (Admissibility)。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 这恰恰描述了传闻证据的定义——为了证明所主张事项的真实性 (To prove the truth of the matter asserted)。正因为目的是为了证明他没进过商店，所以它是传闻，应当被排除。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到证人试图引用自己过去的陈述来支持现在的证词时，请立即警惕 "Bolstering" (增信) 问题。

记住公式：
直接询问 (Direct Exam) + 引用自己过去的一致陈述 = 通常不可采纳 (Inadmissible Hearsay)。

除非题目明确指出对方已经指控其“最近捏造” (Charge of recent fabrication)，否则不要选“先前一致性陈述”这个例外。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a defendant's prosecution for assault, a witness is called to testify that the victim had complained to the witness that the defendant was the assailant.
When is the witness's testimony most likely to be admitted?

choices.A: The witness is a doctor whom the victim consulted for treatment.
choices.B: The witness is a minister whom the victim consulted for counseling.
choices.C: The witness is a police officer whom the victim called on instructions from her husband.
choices.D: The witness is the victim's husband whom she telephoned immediately after the event.

questions.explanation:
Reasoning for common hearsay exceptions
Exception Reason for reliability
  • Present sense impression
  • Excited utterance
 No time to fabricate statement
  • Past recollection recorded
 Records made when fresh in person's mind
  • Then-existing mental/physical condition
 Persons can perceive their own mental or physical state
  • Statement for medical diagnosis/treatment
 Self-interest creates motive for truth
  • Business & public records
  • Documents & statements on property interest
  • Certificates of birth, marriage, baptism
 Accuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. This type of statement is presumed unreliable and is therefore generally inadmissible. But certain statements are excepted from the rule against hearsay because they are inherently reliable (eg, because they would be hard to fabricate). This includes:

  • excited utterances – statements related to a startling event or condition that are made while the declarant is still under the stress of excitement from the event or condition and
  • present sense impressions – statements describing or explaining an event or condition that are made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it.

Here, a witness seeks to testify that the victim had complained to the witness that the defendant was her assailant. This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is being offered for its truth. But if the witness is the victim's husband—whom she telephoned immediately after the assault—the victim's statement likely qualifies as an excited utterance or present sense impression. Therefore, testimony on this statement would most likely be admissible.

(Choice A) Another hearsay exception exists for statements made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment that describe the declarant's medical history, symptoms, or their inception or general cause. Therefore, the doctor could testify to the victim's statements about her medical condition—but not about the assailant's identity (unrelated to the victim's medical care).

(Choices B & C) No hearsay exception exists for out-of-court statements made to clergy (eg, a minister) for the purpose of receiving counsel or for statements made to law enforcement (eg, a police officer).

📌 Educational Objective

Statements excepted from hearsay include statements (1) related to a startling event or condition made while the declarant is still under stress from it (ie, excited utterances) and (2) describing or explaining an event or condition made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it (ie, present sense impressions).

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(1)-(2) (hearsay exceptions – present sense impression, excited utterance).

在一起针对被告人的攻击罪（assault）诉讼中，一名证人被传唤作证，称受害人曾向该证人抱怨被告人是攻击者。

该证人的证言在何种情况下最有可能被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 该证人是受害人为寻求治疗而咨询的医生。
zh-choices.B: 该证人是受害人为寻求心理辅导而咨询的牧师。
zh-choices.C: 该证人是受害人根据其丈夫的指示呼叫的警官。
zh-choices.D: 该证人是受害人的丈夫，她在事件发生后立即给他打了电话。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

证据法 (Evidence) - 传闻证据例外
核心考点：传闻证据 (Hearsay)

庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement）如果用于证明其所述内容的真实性（Truth of the matter asserted），即为传闻证据，原则上不可采纳，除非符合法定例外。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

正确理由

证人是受害人的丈夫，她在事件发生后立即给他打了电话。

这里适用的法律规则是 FRE 803(1) 即时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression) 或 FRE 803(2) 激动言辞 (Excited Utterance)。

  • 激动言辞 (Excited Utterance): 与惊人事件（攻击）有关的陈述，且是在受害人仍处于该事件造成的压力/兴奋状态下作出的。
  • 即时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression): 描述或解释某一事件，且是在感知该事件时或感知后立即 (immediately) 作出的。

🔑 破题关键： 题目中的 "Immediately"（立即）一词是 MBE 考试中暗示这两个例外的强烈信号。受害人在攻击后立即打电话，此时她既没有时间编造谎言（保证了可靠性），也仍处于事件的影响之下。

❌ 干扰项分析

选项 A (医生)

陷阱：医疗诊断例外 (FRE 803(4))

虽然为医疗诊断目的所作的陈述是传闻例外，但这通常仅限于描述症状、病史或受伤的起因。

为什么错： 关于"是谁"造成了伤害（攻击者的身份）通常被认为与医疗诊断或治疗无关。医生不需要知道是谁打了受害人才能治疗她的伤口。因此，指认被告的部分不符合此例外。

选项 B (牧师) & C (警察)

普通传闻

仅仅因为听众是牧师或警察，并不会自动产生传闻证据的例外。

  • 牧师： 可能涉及特权（Privilege），但特权是用来拒绝作证的，而不是让传闻证据变得可采纳。
  • 警察： 受害人对警察的陈述通常被视为“证言性”（Testimonial），在刑事案件中若受害人不出庭，甚至可能违反《第六修正案》对质条款。且警察报告本身在针对被告时通常不符合公共记录例外。
🎓 MBE 实战技巧

看到 "Hearsay" 问题时，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 定位陈述： 谁在庭外说了什么？（受害人说“被告是凶手”）
  2. 确定目的： 是否为了证明内容属实？（是的，为了证明被告确实是凶手） -> 它是传闻。
  3. 寻找例外：
    看到 "Immediately" -> 优先考虑 Present Sense Impression。
    看到 "Screamed", "Crying", "Excited" -> 优先考虑 Excited Utterance。
    看到 "Doctor" -> 警惕 Identity（身份）通常不被采纳。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for bribing a government procurement officer by providing the officer with free vacation facilities. When the defendant was approached by an FBI investigator, the defendant stated that her invitation to the procurement officer to spend his vacation in the defendant's mountain cabin was a favor to a friend, unrelated to his government office. The defendant also said to the investigator that she would reveal some "hot" information on a large-scale fraud in exchange for the investigator's promise to "stop worrying about a little vacation."
Is the investigator's testimony about the defendant's offer to give information admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the defendant made the offer in a negotiation for settlement of a criminal investigation.
choices.C: Yes, as a matter observed and reported by the investigator pursuant to a duty imposed by law.
choices.D: Yes, as a statement of an opposing party.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements
(FRE 801(d))
Statement by
declarant-witness
Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
  • identifies person witness perceived earlier
Statement by
party-opponent
Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
  • made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the rule against hearsay, out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein are generally inadmissible. But under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 801, some out-of-court statements being offered for their truth are excluded from this rule and therefore are nonhearsay. One hearsay exclusion applies to statements made by and offered against an opposing party. As a result, the defendant's offer to give information to the FBI investigator is admissible as a statement of an opposing party (Choice A).

(Choice B) Under FRE 408 and 410, statements made during settlement or plea negotiations are generally inadmissible because public policy encourages the settlement of disputes. But for these rules to apply, both parties must intend to enter settlement negotiations (not seen here). Additionally, in a criminal case, the statements must be made to a prosecuting attorney—not a law enforcement agent (as seen here).

(Choice C) The public records exception to the hearsay rule applies to a public office's records or statements that set out (1) office activities, (2) matters observed by an office representative while under a legal duty to report, and (3) in a civil case or against the government in a criminal case, factual findings from a legally authorized investigation. But this exception is inapplicable here since the defendant's statement is nonhearsay.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements made by an opposing party that are offered against that party are excluded from the hearsay rule.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (opposing party's statement is not hearsay).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因向一名政府采购官员提供免费度假设施而以贿赂罪受审。当被告被联邦调查局（FBI）调查员约谈时，被告声称她邀请采购官员到她的山间小屋度假是对朋友的帮助，与他的政府职务无关。被告还对调查员说，她可以透露一些关于大规模欺诈的“猛料”，以换取调查员承诺“不再为一个小小的假期操心”。

调查员关于被告提出提供信息提议的证词是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为这是不符合任何例外的传闻证据。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为被告是在刑事调查的和解谈判中提出的这一提议。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，作为调查员根据法律规定的职责所观察和报告的事项。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，作为对方当事人的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay & Exclusions
正确答案：D 是的，作为对方当事人的陈述 (Statement of an opposing party)。
⚖️ 核心考点：非传闻证据
Federal Rule of Evidence 801(d)(2) 对方当事人陈述 (Statement of an Opposing Party)：
如果一项陈述是由一方当事人作出的，并且由对方当事人作为证据提出用来针对该当事人，那么该陈述不属于传闻证据 (Non-hearsay)，因此可以直接采纳。

在证据法中，这不仅仅是一个“例外 (Exception)”，而是被定义为“排除 (Exclusion)”，即它从根本上就不被视为传闻。

🔍 逻辑推演
1.
陈述人是谁？
被告 (The Defendant)。她是本案的当事人。
2.
谁在提供证据？
检方（通过FBI调查员的证词）。检方是被告的“对方当事人” (Opposing Party)。
3.
结论：
被告对自己不利的陈述（试图贿赂/交换条件），只要是由检方提出的，就是可采纳的。不需要寻找其他复杂的传闻例外。
⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Distractor Analysis)

为什么选项 B (和解谈判) 是错误的？

很多考生会误以为这是“认罪协商 (Plea Negotiation)”。根据 FRE 410，认罪协商中的陈述确实通常不可采纳，但本题有两个关键点使其不适用：

  1. 对象错误：FRE 410 保护的是与检察官 (Prosecuting Attorney) 的谈判。FBI 探员是执法人员，通常没有权力进行认罪协商，除非有明确授权（本题未提及）。
  2. 性质错误：被告试图用“猛料”换取调查员“不再操心”，这更像是贿赂或妨碍司法的企图，而非善意的法律和解谈判。
💡 考试技巧 (MBE Tips)

在处理 MBE 证据法题目时，请遵循以下思维导图：

  • 看到庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)？ → 怀疑是传闻。
  • 陈述人是被告/当事人吗？ → 检查 801(d)(2)。
  • 如果是当事人陈述且被对方使用 → 直接选“可采纳” (Admissible as Non-hearsay)。
  • 不要被“这是否属于公共记录”或“是否属于反对利益声明”等其他选项干扰，801(d)(2) 是最直接的路径。
